data.text: Neither proposal gives me a reason to accept 8 while someone else takes 14. Let’s agree to 10 tons each: everyone earns $10,000, and the lake returns to 100 tons next month. We can repeat that equal split rather than bargain over unequal shares every month. Since catches are revealed, we can check whether everyone follows through. John, would you support 10 each instead of taking 12?
